text: {"lessons":["Selling winners at a gain feels rewarding, but I should judge the decision by how it affects my whole portfolio, not just that stock’s account.","Realized gains have not prevented my total account value from falling, so I should keep monitoring overall performance rather than assume selling winners protects me.","I have often held through small fluctuations; given my infrequent trading, I should avoid reacting to every monthly move and make changes only for a clear reason."]}
